name: Is a VIP Buyer List better than searching public real estate websites?

mainEntity.name: Is a VIP Buyer List better than searching public real estate websites?

acceptedAnswer.text: A VIP Buyer List offers distinct advantages over public real estate websites, primarily early access to properties not yet available to the general public. While public sites offer broad exposure, VIP lists provide curated, often exclusive opportunities. The choice depends on your strategy: public sites are for general browsing, while a VIP list is for gaining a competitive edge and seeing pre-market or off-market listings in locations like Boca Raton or Key Biscayne. It's often most effective to use both strategies concurrently.
acceptedAnswer.description: A VIP Buyer List provides early, exclusive access to properties not yet public, offering a competitive edge over general public website searches.
